entries.name: explicit-type-args-none-box#0
entries.description: sigmaProp(Global.none[Int].isDefined) — PropertyCall (no arguments): the type byte follows the object directly (PropertyCallSerializer.scala:24). The same tree inside a box. An implementation that leaves the type byte unread takes it as the creation height and every later field shifts by one: the box does not parse at all — an over-reject on a box the JVM accepts.
